{{Quote|These are Trandoshans. They're going to release us and hunt us down for sport.|Katt Mol to fellow prisoner, Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="PL" />}}
'''Katt Mol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who was hunted on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters.

==Biography==
Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Katt Mol was captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and along with other prisoners, including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. He was transported to a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] where he was to be hunted down for sport. He was dumped out of the [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] at night and managed to survive the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from the Trandoshans. However, the next day, he met his fate when he, along with another prisoner [[Lika/Legends|Lika]] were walking along the island. Suddenly, one of the Trandoshan hunters named [[Ratter/Legends|Ratter]] fired at them, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Katt Mol. Lika tried to flee but was soon also killed by Ratter's partner, [[Sochek/Legends|Sochek]].

==Behind the scenes==
Katt Mol's outfit is inspired by the costume worn by [[Zutton/Legends|Zutton]] (nicknamed Snaggletooth), another Snivvian, during the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="EG" />
